goal: Prevent node crashes and buffer overwrites caused by sending oversized message types over P2P
Avoid peer disconnections when RPC commands generate payloads larger than the network limit
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (ajtowns, naiyoma)
Resolved objection on connection stalls when rejecting oversized payloads (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes buffer overruns and aborts triggered by oversized message types
Protects node stability and prevents unintended peer disconnections
